_comment: Solid-hurdle jumping curriculum (#286), v3 — targets reliably chaining MULTIPLE 0.50m solid leaps. Warm-started from the v2 net (already clears one 0.50m wall), it re-confirms the leap, then adds a 0.50m hurdle at a time (two->three->max) so the policy learns to LAND-RECOVER-LEAP repeatedly, dwelling on the full 4x0.50m course for the bulk of training. Paired with the world scene's landing-recovery reward (looser fall_height/fall_upright so a hard landing recovers, clear_bonus=5 per hurdle, finish_bonus for completing). Promotes on success_rate (>=1 clear); the per-hurdle clear_bonus + long dwell on max drive the actual chaining.
